english.title: Transport a live / dead wild plant of a European protected species
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) transported

(A)_[a live]_
(B)_[a dead]_
(C)_[a part of a]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY..) that was derived from a]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY..) that was derived from part of a]_

plant which had been taken in the wild and was of a species or subspecies listed in Annex II(b) or Annex IV(b) to the Habitats Directive
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 47(2)(b) and (7) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 47(6) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 provides that in any proceedings for this offence, where it is alleged that a plant or a part of a plant was taken in the wild, it is presumed, unless the contrary is shown, that that plant or part of a plant was taken in the wild.
